scope: Two-node Ethernet keepalive and peer-link control-plane validation, native single-member/range parser restrictions, port-channel defaults and VRF migration. This is a reviewed run on a booted owned lab following retained expectation failures; it is not an uninterrupted fresh-boot capture or a complete NX-OS certification. Native ports 1/1-3 map to simulator ports 1/27-29.
